name: Butterfly Witch of the Lost Mountain
source:
A story of a simple man and a resented forest in the Lost Mountain. Witness the story of an undying love between Leon and the Butterfly Witch.

[From [url=https://sylphoniagamesph.itch.io/butterfly-witch-in-the-lost-mountain] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个普通人与失落山中一座遭人怨恨的森林的故事。见证里昂与蝴蝶女巫之间不朽的爱。

（来源：[url=https://sylphoniagamesph.itch.io/butterfly-witch-in-the-lost-mountain]itch.io[/url]）
